Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 42
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Hermann Friedrich Graebe died first when it was actually Louis-René de Caradeuc de La Chalotais who died first. The Planner seems to have misinterpreted the historical timeline by stating Graebe died first based on the year 1986 being earlier than 1785, which is a clear chronological error. The correct conclusion should have been that Louis-René de Caradeuc de La Chalotais, who died in 1785, died before Hermann Friedrich Graebe, who died in 1986.
